test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which rapper, known for the indie album 'Halaat', has risen from the slums of Dharavi to the forefront of Indian hip hop music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MC Altaf**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **MC Altaf**

 
 
• Real Name: Altaf Shaikh
 
• Origin: Dharavi, Mumbai, India
 
• Style: Raw, Bronx-inspired hip-hop with a focus on social commentary and street narratives.
 
• Key Works: "Soch," "Robin Hood," "Halaat" (debut album), "Chooke Dekh" (feat. DIVINE, Sammohit)
 
• Notable Achievements:
 
• Featured in the Bollywood film "Gully Boy" (2019)
 
• Mentored actor Ranveer Singh in "Bambaiya" dialect for "Gully Boy"
 
• Signed to DIVINE's Gully Gang Entertainment
 
• Known for his authentic portrayal of life in Dharavi
 
• Collaborated with prominent artists like DIVINE, Shah Rule, and Raftaar.
 
• Social Impact: MC Altaf's music often sheds light on the challenges faced by those living in underprivileged communities, giving voice to their struggles and aspirations.
 
• Evolution: While starting with a raw, boom-bap sound, Altaf has experimented with different styles, including trap and more melodic approaches, while maintaining his lyrical focus.
 
• Influence: He is considered an influential figure in the Mumbai hip-hop scene, inspiring aspiring rappers with his storytelling and authentic delivery.
 
• Recent Work: His debut album "Halaat" (2024) is a culmination of his experiences and a testament to his growth as an artist.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Naezy**

 
 
• Real Name: Naved Shaikh
 
• Origin: Mumbai, India
 
• Style: Conscious hip-hop with socially relevant lyrics, often addressing issues of poverty, inequality, and political issues.
 
• Key Works: "Mere Gully Mein," "Aafat," "Mumbai 70," "Khamakha"
 
• Notable Achievements:
 
• One of the pioneers of the "gully rap" movement in India
 
• Featured in the documentary "Gully Life: The Story of Divine and Naezy"
 
• Known for his raw and honest storytelling
 
• His music has been featured in several films and TV shows.
 
• Social Impact: Naezy's music has played a significant role in bringing social issues to the forefront of the Indian hip-hop scene.
 
• Influence: He has inspired a generation of rappers to use their voices to address social and political concerns.
 
• Collaborations: Naezy has collaborated with a wide range of artists, including DIVINE, as well as international musicians.
 
• Evolution: While maintaining his focus on conscious lyrics, Naezy has also experimented with different musical styles, incorporating elements of trap, dancehall, and other genres.
 
• Recent Work: He continues to release music that challenges the status quo and encourages listeners to think critically about the world around them.1 
 
 
 
• **Divine**
 
 
• Real Name: Vivian Fernandes
 
• Origin: Mumbai, India
 
• Style: Versatile hip-hop with a blend of street rap, trap, and conscious lyrics.
 
• Key Works: "Mere Gully Mein" (with Naezy), "Jungli Sher," "Kaam 25," "Farak"
 
• Notable Achievements:
 
• Considered one of the most influential figures in the Indian hip-hop scene
 
• His life story inspired the Bollywood film "Gully Boy"
 
• Founder of Gully Gang Entertainment, a platform for emerging hip-hop artists
 
• Collaborated with international artists like Nas
 
• Known for his powerful stage presence and energetic performances.
 
• Social Impact: Divine's music has helped to bring Indian hip-hop to a global audience and has inspired countless young people to pursue their dreams.
 
• Influence: He is a role model for many aspiring rappers and has helped to shape the sound of contemporary Indian hip-hop.
 
• Business Acumen: In addition to his music, Divine is also a successful entrepreneur, building the Gully Gang brand into a major force in the Indian music industry.
 
• Evolution: Divine has constantly evolved his sound, experimenting with different styles and incorporating elements of various genres into his music.
 
• Recent Work: He continues to release music that pushes boundaries and challenges listeners, while also supporting and mentoring new talent through Gully Gang.
 
 
 
• **Emiway Bantai**
 
 
• Real Name: Bilal Shaikh
 
• Origin: Mumbai, India
 
• Style: Aggressive, battle-oriented rap with a focus on lyrical dexterity and wordplay.
 
• Key Works: "Machayenge," "Aila Re Ailla," "Samajh Mein Aaya Kya," "Khatam"
 
• Notable Achievements:
 
• Known for his high-energy performances and freestyle skills
 
• Gained popularity through his YouTube channel, where he posts music videos and vlogs
 
• Engaged in a highly publicized "beef" with fellow rapper Raftaar
 
• Has a large and dedicated fan base.
 
• Lyrical Prowess: Emiway is known for his intricate rhyme schemes, rapid-fire delivery, and clever wordplay.
 
• Independent Artist: He has maintained his independence from major record labels, building his career through his own efforts and connecting directly with his fans.
 
• Controversies: Emiway has been involved in several controversies, including his public dispute with Raftaar, which generated a lot of attention in the Indian hip-hop community.
 
• Evolution: While initially known for his battle rap style, Emiway has also explored other themes and styles in his music, including more introspective and melodic tracks.
 
• Recent Work: He continues to release music and perform for his fans, maintaining his position as one of the most popular independent rappers in India.
